def transform(grid):
    """Return the overlap of the two nonzero masks separated by a solid divider."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A full-width line separates a top and bottom mask.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == row[0] for v in row) and row[0] != 0]
    # A full-height line separates a left and right mask.
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and grid[0][c] != 0]

    # The separator is a uniform-color row/column; prefer an interior separator
    # that leaves two equally sized panels.
    for r in sep_rows:
        if r > 0 and r + 1 < h and r == h // 2:
            a, b = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            if len(a) == len(b):
                return [[2 if a[i][j] != 0 and b[i][j] != 0 else 0
                         for j in range(w)] for i in range(len(a))]
    for c in sep_cols:
        if c > 0 and c + 1 < w and c == w // 2:
            left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            right = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
            if len(left[0]) == len(right[0]):
                return [[2 if left[i][j] != 0 and right[i][j] != 0 else 0
                         for j in range(len(left[0]))] for i in range(h)]
    raise ValueError('No centered solid divider found')
